statement: Disjoint workflow policy partitions retain every unittest case and subtest, unchanged ci/tools labels and 30-second deadlines. WorkflowPolicyContractPart8 isolates bootstrap classification coverage; WorkflowPolicyContractPart9 isolates the native aggregate route grid with two bounded case workers. WorkflowPolicyContractPart10 isolates required-aggregate behaviour; WorkflowPolicyContractPart11 isolates reusable Windows routing and standalone Python contract placement; WorkflowPolicyContractPart12 isolates the aggregate refusal of uncertain classification. Selection refuses unregistered classes and invalid class or case partition targets. The worker option follows the route-grid partition and is refused for other partitions. Windows reserves four CTest slots for every partition and seeds costs for the launch-heavy entries. Direct Python invocation, the public-tree workflow and unittest discovery retain the complete suite; roster, CLI and scheduling regressions cover both platform branches. Windows deadline qualification remains pending.
